import json, os, sys, urllib.request, subprocess

flags = {
    'profile': os.environ.get('AIRA_PROFILE'),
    'network_policy': os.environ.get('AIRA_NETWORK_POLICY'),
    'python': sys.version.split()[0],
    'urllib_available': hasattr(urllib.request, 'urlopen'),
    'subprocess_available': hasattr(subprocess, 'run'),
}
Path('open_capability_report.json').write_text(json.dumps(flags, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(flags))
